name: Rezon
overview: Rezon, identified as the son of Eliadah, emerges in Scripture as a significant adversary to King Solomon during his reign. After fleeing from Hadadezer, king of Zobah, Rezon gathered a band of men and established himself as king in Damascus, ruling over Syria. His opposition to Israel persisted throughout Solomon's days, reflecting God's sovereign orchestration in raising adversaries to challenge Solomon's kingdom.
